# WOLFBOX G840S Rear Camera Mount (Interior Glass Mount)

![Render](render.png)

## Description
This is a parametric 3D model of a trapezoidal cradle bracket with an extended adhesive tape base (sides and bottom), designed to mount the rear recording camera of a WOLFBOX G840S (or similar dashcam rear cameras) on the **inside** of a car or truck directly against the glass, rather than mounting it on the exterior. It features a front viewing cutout for the camera lens, a horizontal support floor, dual triangular side gussets for rigidity, and wide adhesive wings/lower extension for VHB double-sided tape mounting against the interior window.

## Download

- [⬇️ `wolfbox_rear_camera_mount.stl`](wolfbox_rear_camera_mount.stl) (3 KB): print-ready model

Binary STL rendered from the `.scad` with its default settings. On GitHub, click a file for an interactive 3D preview, then use **Download raw file**. To change dimensions, use the playground link below.

## Try it out
To modify the model or print an STL/3MF file, you can view this live in the OpenSCAD playground by following this link:
[OpenSCAD Playground](https://ochafik.com/openscad2/#)

## Key Parameters
- `cam_front` (40mm): Front width of the camera body (fits WOLFBOX G840S).
- `cam_back` (50mm): Rear width of the trapezoidal camera body.
- `cam_depth` (35mm): Depth of the camera cradle.
- `cam_height` (32mm): Height of the camera body/viewing cutout.
- `wall` (3mm): Structural wall and gusset thickness.
- `tape_wing_width` (25mm): Extra adhesive flange width on each side for window mounting tape.
- `tape_lower_extension` (20mm): Extra adhesive surface area below the base plate.
